visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black cap, a Tamiya-branded t-shirt, and large over-ear headphones sits in a dark grey gaming chair. He holds a blue PlayStation-style game controller, looking toward a desk adorned with neon PlayStation icons and stacked vintage Game Boy boxes. Behind him, a narrow doorway peeks into a bright hallway where one woman in black and another in a white top begin to emerge. (2) The man turns his head slightly, mouth agape in exaggerated surprise as a group of approximately five women smile and wave from the doorway. The women are dressed in varied casual and fashion outfits, peeking over each other's shoulders. The setting is a modern, wood-paneled apartment with warm overhead lighting. (3) The women suddenly vanish and the door slams shut. The man stands up, wearing a look of bewilderment, and walks toward the closed door. He opens it to find an empty hallway, scratches his head, and returns to his seat to resume his gaming, still looking confused at the camera.
